rv.q: The show whizzes by briskly and brightly, and there's always another of Ashman and Alan Menken's infectiously bopping songs just ahead to set the pulse racing.

As a matter of fact, nothing in Little Shop of Horrors remains benevolent. Narrated by a neighborhood girl group whose members are Chiffon (DeQuina Moore), Crystal (Trisha Jeffrey), and Ronnette (Carla J. Hargrove), the musical is a mock fairy tale very much influenced by the Grimm Brothers and having a good deal in common with Sweeney Todd.

ca.r: Orin, Bernstein, Snip, Luce and Everyone Else
